title: Vivah - Journey From Engagement to Marriage
desc: Poonam, an orphan engaged to wealthy Prem, suffers first-degree burns in a house fire just days before their wedding, testing love, resilience, and family bonds.

title: Andaz Apna Apna
desc: Two ambitious rivals chase wealth by pursuing an heiress, but their plans spiral into confusion when a family plot and hidden identity create unexpected trouble.

title: Rustom
desc: Rustom is a navy officer happily married to Cynthia. When he finds out she's cheating with his friend Vikram, things turn tragic, and Rustom is blamed for murder.

title: Jawan
desc: A man fueled by a long-held promise sets out to fix the injustices around him, but his mission turns perilous when he confronts a fearless, ruthless outlaw responsible for immense suffering.

desc: Raj, Neelam, and Boney prank Sheetal's father with a fake kidnapping, but chaos ensues when Sheetal goes missing, putting them under suspicion and testing their innocence.

title: Odela 2
desc: In a remote village with rich traditions, the savior Odela Mallanna Swamy always protects his people from evil forces.

title: Chaalbaaz
desc: Separated twins Anju and Manju grow up differently and accidentally swap lives. Shy Anju enters a rustic world, while bold Manju bravely takes revenge on their evil uncle.

desc: CA Keswani is arrested for bank fraud and forgery. Keswani hires Birbal, a lawyer, to fight his case, but Birbal realises that there's more to it than meets the eye.

desc: Bharat struggles to navigate family leadership and responsibility after his father's death, confronting personal challenges and emotional turmoil while striving to keep his family united and strong..

title: Baazigar
desc: Ajay Sharma seduces and kills a businessman's daughter, staging it as a suicide. He then plots to destroy the entire family, driven by a cold vendetta.

title: Company
desc: Chandu and Mallik form a gang and gain notoriety. But ego and tension tear them apart, leading to betrayal and the collapse of their criminal empire.

title: Sirf Tum
desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love through letters without ever meeting or knowing each other's address. Longing to see him, Aarti finally travels to Delhi to search for her true love.

title: Saheb Biwi Aur Gangster 3
desc: After returning from jail, Aditya seeks to reclaim his political legacy, but his encounter with London based gangster Uday sparks a fierce battle for power and survival.

title: Jism

title: Race
desc: Two stepbrothers run a lavish stud farm and horse racing empire. When they fall for the same woman, jealousy turns deadly-one plots murder to claim love and insurance money.
